name: Cloak
description: For those warriors who covet the power of Soul, the Path of the Cloak enables them to achieve speeds beyond their limits.

abilities.name: Swoop
abilities.description: Once per round, perform dash or jump action for free. Can initiate dash/jump actions in midair (once each before landing).

abilities.name: Combat Celerity
abilities.description: When attacking (after Stamina initiation), may dedicate Soul as well as Stamina. When dodging, may dedicate Soul instead of Stamina.

abilities.name: Cloaked in Wind
abilities.description: Dashing/jumping doesn't provoke attacks, can pass through occupied spaces, +1 dash/jump distance, +1 post-dodge movement.

abilities.name: Speed of Soul
abilities.description: May spend Soul instead of Stamina for dash/jump actions.
